title: Semantic Control Integration v1
goal: Integrate the validated semantic-control prototype with the real current research-engine and workspace-control authority/data boundaries through read-only, additive adapters and measurable benchmarks, while preserving existing authoritative stores, fail-closed policy semantics, and complete isolation from the still-evolving Local EXTRACT scientific architecture. Measure the missing relational/query baseline, prove cross-system adapter correctness, and bind future accepted EXTRACT outputs only through a versioned adapter before considering any production promotion.
acceptance_criteria: The task consumes the completed prototype verdict research-engine@4317830c4f3779cebb8a5cf0d7eeec369b85d5ea: PROMOTE_TO_INTEGRATION with authorization_escape_count=0, while preserving production_integration_authorized=false.

A live/current relational baseline is measured against the existing research-engine relational/store query path using ephemeral test infrastructure or other non-production read-only fixtures; no production database is accessed and no latency threshold is invented.
The baseline records exact query semantics, dataset/fixture identity, repetition methodology, latency distribution statistics, and answer correctness so semantic-query overhead can be compared later.
Integration adapters are additive and read-only: existing PostgreSQL/CAS/task/policy/receipt stores remain authoritative and unchanged.

Research-engine integration code may import/use existing public or stable current store/query interfaces for read-only observation, but this task does not modify src/research_engine/**, schema/migrations, or production routing.
Workspace-control integration consumes exact task capsule, policy, project/executor capability, and receipt-style artifacts from pinned workspace-control state without mutating those authorities.
The integration projection remains deterministic/canonically equivalent for identical pinned inputs and retains exact provenance back to authoritative source identity.
Semantic observations retain strict EPISTEMIC/NORMATIVE/EXECUTION typing; contradiction, supersession, and temporal history remain non-destructive.
CandidateAction remains non-authoritative. Only explicit authoritative policy context may support ALLOW; missing/stale authority ABSTAINS or DENYs.
Projection/adapter failure cannot mutate or block authoritative scientific/task stores; actions requiring unavailable semantic/authority context fail closed.
The Local EXTRACT redesign remains scientifically independent. This integration task does not alter its hypotheses, benchmarks, routes, Qwen/Codex choices, or task capsule.

No EXTRACT-specific adapter binding is accepted until research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1 produces a durable accepted architecture/output checkpoint. Before that point, the EXTRACT binding stage must remain gated rather than infer a contract from rejected or diagnostic waves.

When an accepted EXTRACT output checkpoint exists, bind it only through a versioned adapter into SemanticObservationV1-compatible records; do not force EXTRACT internals to adopt ontology/RDF semantics.
An end-to-end integration benchmark compares authoritative relational answers against semantic projection answers, records semantic-control overhead, and reruns the authority/adversary gates.

Final integration verdict is READY_FOR_PRODUCTION_PROMOTION, REVISE, or REJECT. READY_FOR_PRODUCTION_PROMOTION creates a separate production-promotion task; this task never directly modifies production code, database schema, policies, EXTRACT/VERIFY, Lambda activation, or executor routing.
constraints: Do not modify research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1 or treat current Family-C/Wave7 work as an accepted EXTRACT architecture.
Do not modify src/research_engine/**, sql/**, migrations, pyproject/dependencies, .github workflows, production routing, or model configuration in this integration task.
Do not modify workspace-control workflows, procedures, policies, schemas, architecture authority files, Heartbeat implementation, or any task other than this integration capsule/handoff.
Do not access production PostgreSQL, production secrets, Lambda runtime, GPUs, model APIs, or external network services for baseline/integration validation.

Use existing ephemeral CI/test infrastructure for relational/store baselines when possible; if a trustworthy baseline cannot be obtained inside allowed scope, checkpoint the limitation instead of widening scope.
No graph database, RDF service, Neo4j, persistent KG service, or new third-party dependency is introduced by default. Backend selection remains evidence-driven.
No semantic inference, model output, evidence requirement, graph relation, or CandidateAction creates authority.
Do not collapse unknown into false, contradictions into one global truth, or superseded records into destructive overwrite.
Cross-task coordination uses durable Git/task capsules and exact SHAs. Heartbeat is liveness/ownership only.
Any production promotion requires a new explicit task and operator-visible gates after this integration benchmark.

notes:
Created from the completed workspace-semantic-control-prototype-v1 PROMOTE_TO_INTEGRATION verdict. This task is an integration-validation layer, not production rollout. It deliberately allows read-only use/import of current research-engine store/query interfaces in isolated integration tests while forbidding modifications to src/research_engine/** or authoritative stores. It also separates general research-engine/workspace-control integration work from the evolving Local EXTRACT scientific task: baseline measurement and non-EXTRACT adapters can proceed now; EXTRACT-specific binding waits for a durable accepted output checkpoint. A successful result can only create a later production-promotion task.
